steps.title: Define App Startup Loader Structure
steps.description: Establish a full-screen, responsive backdrop blur overlay with branded icon and progress indicator in index.html.

steps.title: Style Preloader Keyframes and Brand Spinners
steps.description: Add glowing ambient pulsing effects, rotating ring borders, and smooth progress track transitions in style.css.

steps.title: Support Theme-Aware Preloader Appearance
steps.description: Ensure the startup overlay seamlessly reflects both light (default) and dark themes according to persisted preferences.

steps.title: Implement Progress Simulation and Lifecycle in Script
steps.description: Add lifecycle controller to step progress realistically on launch and dismiss gracefully on document completion.

steps.title: Configure Smooth Dissolve Transitions
steps.description: Implement opacity fade-out and pointer event deactivation so the calculator controls are interactive instantly after load.

steps.title: Ensure Audio & State Continuity During Load
steps.description: Verify Web Audio API contexts and state initialization cleanly initialize while the loader is active.

steps.title: Verify Mobile Viewport and Screen Reader Accessibility
steps.description: Ensure the loader container respects aria attributes, role alert/status tags, and high-DPI displays.

steps.title: Optimize Cold Start and Cache Fallbacks
steps.description: Guard against hanging states with a maximum threshold timeout to guarantee dismissal under any network state.

steps.title: Harmonize Keypad and Display Interaction
steps.description: Confirm all calculator operations, history drawer, scientific buttons, and converters operate flawlessly post-loader.

steps.title: Building moderncalc
steps.description: Complete final verification of the startup loader, seamless fade transition, calculation engine, and responsive UI layout.
